test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In which of the following Indian states, is Makar Sankranti celebrated by the name of 'Magha Saaji'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Makar Sankranti** is a **Hindu festival **celebrated across India to mark the transition of the sun into the **zodiac sign of Capricorn.**
 
• It is also known as** Maghi in Punjab, Uttarayan in Gujarat, Pongal in Tamil Nadu,** and** Bihu in Assam.**
 
• In **Himachal Pradesh**, Makar Sankranti is celebrated by the name of **Magha Saaji.**
 
• It is a major festival for the people of the state, especially in the **Kinnaur district,** where it is celebrated for a week with great fervor.
 
• Magha Saaji is celebrated on the **first day of the Hindu month of Magha**, which usually falls in **mid-January.**
 
• People take a dip in the** holy waters of the Sutlej river **and offer prayers to **Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In** Punjab,** Makar Sankranti is celebrated as Maghi, which is also the day when **Lohri **is celebrated.
 
• People** light bonfires, sing and dance** around them, and** offer traditional foods **like gur and rewari.
 
• In Uttarakhand, it is celebrated as** Ghughuti,** while in Jharkhand, it is known as** Tusu.**
 
• Both these festivals involve **singing, dancing, and offering prayers to the deities.**
